lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
markdown-it: 151,773 B in 52 modules on the kanso-main page, of which its root lib/index.mjs is 5,599 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
All 4 pages load the same 1 file: 218,422 B raw, 80,367 B gzip, 65.1 % of the smallest page (kanso-public, 335,666 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 53,952 B, axios 46,215 B, dompurify 30,555 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 29,456 B, @vue/reactivity 18,084 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,456 B on the kanso-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
